plain_meaning: A distinguished candidate beats every other candidate with probability at least 1−ε.

plain_meaning: Start all candidate weights at one, choose each pivot proportionally to its weight, record it, and discount other weights by their probabilities of beating that pivot. Stop changes once total weight is zero.
why_needed: Separates the finite probabilistic argument from its quantum implementation.
hard_step: Use a separate zero-weight branch so no 0/0 probability is formed. All weights stay in [0,1]. This process is conceptual: the algorithm need not numerically compute its weights.

plain_meaning: After pivot p, replace each candidate’s weight by its old weight times its chance of beating p.
why_needed: Encodes survival against all previously chosen pivots as a product.
hard_step: The pivot’s own weight becomes zero, ensuring no already selected pivot can be sampled again. The product is over fresh comparison experiments conditional on a candidate index.

plain_meaning: The expected remaining total weight is exactly (W²−Σ_i w_i²)/(2W), and is at most W/2.
why_needed: Gives exponential contraction despite arbitrary nonwinner comparisons.
hard_step: Pair terms (p,i) and (i,p); their probabilities sum to one. Diagonal terms vanish. Nonnegative weights are needed to interpret the algebra as a sampling expectation, though the algebraic identity itself is more general.

plain_meaning: After T ideal stages, expected total weight is at most m/2^T.
why_needed: Quantifies how small the remaining mass becomes.
hard_step: Apply the one-step conditional expectation inequality recursively; extend it by zero at W=0. No independence across stages is required.

plain_meaning: Until the distinguished candidate has been selected, its weight remains at least (1−ε)^t≥1−Tε=999/1000.

hard_step: Every recorded pivot is different from the unselected winner; each relevant factor is at least 1−ε. Bernoulli’s inequality applies because 0<ε<1.

plain_meaning: One oracle call changes the weighted state-overlap potential by at most twice the largest coordinate-restricted adversary norm.

plain_meaning: Two unit states producing opposite answers with error at most one third cannot have inner product larger than 2 sqrt(2)/3 in magnitude.
